title: When the Garden Falls Again
author: Isandro Oyelaran
blurb: Mara Nakamura, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
